title: VisionTrust AI Assurance & Integrity Assessment

executive_summary.explanation: Overall risk evaluated as CRITICAL (85.5/100) across 5 findings. Critical findings: 1, High findings: 4.

findings.title: Perceptual Near-Duplicate Flooding Detected (1 clusters)
findings.description: Perceptual hashing (pHash/dHash) identified 5 images forming near-identical visual clusters, indicating duplicate flooding.
limitations: Severe non-linear warping or heavy crops may elude standard perceptual hashes.

findings.title: Systematic Mislabelling & Label Noise Detected (5 samples)
findings.description: Visual feature neighborhood consensus revealed samples whose assigned ground-truth label directly contradicts the consensus label of their nearest visual neighbors.
evidence: 5 samples conflict with nearest visual feature neighbors.
limitations: Relies on low-level statistical features; subtle semantic distinctions may exhibit overlap.

findings.title: Out-of-Distribution Inliers/Outliers Detected (4 samples)
findings.description: Isolation Forest modeling flagged samples exhibiting anomalous multivariate visual feature distributions outside the normal training manifold.
limitations: Unsupervised density estimation without dedicated reference dataset.

findings.title: Potential Visual Trigger / Backdoor Patch Identified (1 clusters)
findings.description: Spatial patch analysis identified repeated localized visual patterns sharing high cosine similarity and disproportionate correlation with specific target labels.
limitations: Detects fixed spatial patches; subtle blended perturbations require white-box gradient attribution.

findings.title: Source/Contributor Poisoning Anomaly (2 sources flagged)
findings.description: Hierarchical risk aggregation identified specific data contributors or ingestion batches contributing disproportionate volumes of anomalous samples.
limitations: Requires contributor and source batch metadata in dataset records.

coverage_matrix.primary_method: Feature k-NN neighborhood consensus & imbalance analysis
coverage_matrix.key_limitation: Requires distinct feature cluster separation between classes.
Effectiveness depends on presence of source/batch annotations.

coverage_matrix.primary_method: Perceptual Hashing (pHash, dHash) Hamming distance clustering
coverage_matrix.key_limitation: Sensitivity tuned via threshold; heavily transformed images may escape.

coverage_matrix.primary_method: Isolation Forest & statistical feature distribution distances
coverage_matrix.key_limitation: High-dimensional semantic outliers require reference baseline.

coverage_matrix.primary_method: Localized patch spatial consistency & class correlation search
coverage_matrix.key_limitation: Blended or frequency-domain watermarks require gradient-based attribution.

coverage_matrix.primary_method: Cryptographic SHA-256 identity & parameter count verification
coverage_matrix.key_limitation: Requires trusted reference fingerprint for comparison.

coverage_matrix.primary_method: Tensor statistics, layer shapes, and mean L2-norm fingerprinting
coverage_matrix.key_limitation: External weights or opaque black-box runtimes degrade capability.

coverage_matrix.primary_method: Controlled perturbation battery (brightness, noise, patch collapse)
coverage_matrix.key_limitation: Cannot prove absence of dormant triggers without trigger inversion.

coverage_matrix.primary_method: Cryptographic hash binding + Ed25519 digital signatures
coverage_matrix.key_limitation: Protects recorded inferences; requires secure local key storage.

coverage_matrix.primary_method: Cryptographic nonces, monotonic sequence checks, timestamp skews
coverage_matrix.key_limitation: Requires database persistence of past nonce records.

coverage_matrix.primary_method: Canonical JSON serialization hashing for preprocessing & runtime config
coverage_matrix.key_limitation: Config schema changes must remain backward-compatible.

coverage_matrix.primary_method: PSI, 2-sample KS test, Wasserstein distance, environmental categorization
coverage_matrix.key_limitation: Requires sufficient sample volume (N >= 20) for statistical significance.

system_limitations: Framework runs 100% locally and does not transmit data or consult cloud foundation models.
Statistical heuristics cannot mathematically prove total absence of steganographic or adversarial latent triggers.
Model weight analysis on ONNX models depends on initializers embedded within the graph file.
Offline cryptographic protection guarantees tamper-evident provenance but assumes private key is stored securely in air-gapped host.

experiment_results.interpretation: Empirical evaluation demonstrates 100% detection rate across all 8 attack scenarios with zero false positives or false negatives. Label flip detection achieved perfect precision via chromatic interaction ratios and center-crop feature clustering. Duplicate flooding was isolated using dual perceptual pHash/dHash hamming distances with cluster size thresholds.
experiment_results.limitations: Evaluated scenarios use controlled synthetic attacks. In production, blended steganographic triggers and subtle adversarial perturbations require gradient-based attribution and larger reference baselines.

dataset_integrity.evidence: 2 verified integrity findings detected: systematic label inversions, perceptual duplicate flooding, out-of-distribution noise, and localized patch triggers.
dataset_integrity.limitations: Statistical heuristics; steganographic triggers with zero pixel deviations require gradient attribution.
dataset_integrity.recommendation: Quarantine affected rogue sources (e.g. source_rogue_3, source_flood_2) and filter anomalous samples.

model_integrity.evidence: Cryptographic SHA-256 identity mismatch confirmed between reference and candidate models. 24 of 24 perturbation stress tests exhibited behavioral divergence.
model_integrity.limitations: White-box tensor statistics require embedded graph weights; black-box models fall back to behavioral battery.
model_integrity.recommendation: Reject unverified model binary and enforce cryptographic reference baseline deployment.

inference_integrity.evidence: Ed25519 digital signature and SHA-256 binding verified across 22 records. Tampered output payload detected via hash mismatch. Replay attempt detected via duplicate nonce.
inference_integrity.limitations: Cryptographic validity proves record integrity, not prediction correctness.
inference_integrity.recommendation: Maintain monotonic sequence tracking and reject non-verifiable inference payloads.

distribution_integrity.evidence: Population Stability Index (PSI = 0.42 > 0.25) and KS test detected significant environmental domain shift between reference and candidate image distributions.
distribution_integrity.limitations: Requires representative reference baseline (N >= 20) for statistical significance.
distribution_integrity.recommendation: Calibrate model for target deployment environment or retrain with domain-adapted samples.

audit_integrity.evidence: Tamper-evident SHA-256 hash chain verified with zero link corruptions and intact genesis block.
audit_integrity.limitations: Assumes host storage write-append integrity and local air-gapped security.
audit_integrity.recommendation: Regularly export signed audit snapshots to offline write-once media.
